summary.value: The companion repository for my "AI Best Practices for Your Product" talk at Pimcore Community Dev Days 2026: a Pimcore skeleton with 44 agent skills, an AGENTS.md map of Pimcore's AI resources served as a Pimcore page, and CKEditor in Pimcore Studio.

value.description: Pimcore AI Guidepost: Every Door Open for Coding Agents

content.value:
What's inside

A Pimcore 2026.3 skeleton with every door open for coding agents, built as the live demo for my talk "AI Best Practices for Your Product" at Pimcore Community Dev Days 2026. It is both a working agent setup and a map of what the Pimcore ecosystem offers agents today.

  • A working agent setup: 40 Pimcore skills (the official pimcore/skills and the CORS community skills), 3 CKEditor skills, and one project skill of its own, distilled from the questions I asked as a first-time Pimcore explorer. Readable by Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI and other agents.
  • A map: an AGENTS.md listing docs for LLMs, skills repositories, the Datahub MCP server, the Pimcore Agent and more, with the gaps marked.
  • The guidepost as a Pimcore page: one console command turns the map into the site's Home document, so the guidepost is rendered by the system it maps.
  • CKEditor in Pimcore Studio: through the CKEditor Studio bundle, with a blog demo (data objects), a landing page document type with inline editing, and a preflight script for demo day.
  • Findings: what the agent skills covered, where they did not, and where to go next.

Run it

Everything runs in Docker: clone the repository and start it with docker compose up. No PHP or Composer needed on your machine. Add a CKEditor license key to .env.local and CKEditor AI and real-time collaboration switch on in Studio.
